provenance.movement_reasoning: Shared meals, packing, school and work repeatedly move containers, bags, and personal carry items through the kitchen and entry. Elena resets reading, medication, homework, and dish clutter; children spread screens, toys, and schoolwork through common areas. Trip rules return carried belongings to their customary landing places at homecoming, while occasional NO_OP preserves items that are not used every time.
provenance.persona_reasoning: A five-person household with a retired grandmother, two working parents, and two school-age children requires a mix of personal carry items, school/work gear, shared kitchen objects, and care items that plausibly circulate through common rooms.
